periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique downward orientation at approximately a 45-degree angle toward the muzzle relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward taper with the inferior margin extending notably further from the geometric center than the superior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shaped curvature along the posterior boundary of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Substantial thickness occupying roughly 30-40% of the visible anterior-dorsal torso region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide cranial separation approximately equivalent to twice the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Regular, smooth semicircular curvature at the apex of both visible ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent visibility of five dark, sharp ungual processes (claws) on the extended right forelimb.
